summary: Basilan representative with 184 principal-authored bills. Reviewed evidence shows electric-cooperative debt relief and minimum-wage support, and co-authorship of anti-dynasty bills.
caveat: Only a small slice of the bill record was surfaced; score is low confidence and could change with full review.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Principal author of debt-condonation bills for the Basilan electric cooperative (state-backed relief) and co-author of national minimum wage. Narrow issue coverage drives the score; pattern across 184 other bills not reviewed.
